text: Could you watch this clip and write a short English voice-over explaining what's happening in it? I’m asking because I sometimes get too caught up in choosing the words and would rather leave that part to someone else. What I want is for your narration to replace the original conversation, rather than keeping that conversation underneath it. Somewhere in all of that, I should mention that all 10 seconds of footage need to stay unchanged, with no music or captions. Please make the narration friendly and matter-of-fact. You can pick both the wording and the voice.
